character.name: 游方符师 / wandering talisman adept
character.desc: Elderly Chinese man with long white beard and grey eyebrows, soft charcoal scholar headwrap, ochre patched robe with dark edging, rope belt, brass gourd at waist and yellow paper talisman cards. Carries talismans in right hand; no sword or spear. Slender hunched scholarly silhouette.
character.special: mana restoration ritual, raise yellow talismans then draw hands toward chest then open palms
